hook: Leave your Sleepers alone and they bank Rest, so every buff they get, from any card, lands twice.
loop: Leave Sleepers unbought, unplayed and unmoved so they bank Rest.
Rest makes every permanent buff land twice, from any tribe.
Cash it in: flood it out in fights, or chain Wakes.

growth.line: Each unmoved Sleeper banks 2 Rest a turn; Rest doubles permanent buffs, peaking with Tier 6 cash-ins.

feel.early: Soft bodies, holding still, little to spend Rest on
feel.mid: Cloister and Old Polh make buffs land doubled
feel.late: Dragon flood, Robber-Knight lending, or Ribica's copies

stars.why: Floods a whole game's Rest into stats every fight.
Its Wake buffs neighbours, emptying their Rest so they Wake too.
Eats everyone's Rest: drains the hoard, but drives the Wake chain.

card_short.u01: Has Hunker while it holds Rest.
card_short.u02: Wake: grows and regains Rest; playing beside it wakes it.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: permanently buffs the units behind it.
card_short.u04: When played: gives two other units 3 Rest.
card_short.u05: Gold each turn you moved no units.
card_short.u06: Neighbours build Rest like Sleepers, plus 1 extra.
card_short.u07: End of Turn: gives 1 Rest to every Rest-less unit.
card_short.u08: Wake: permanently buffs the units beside it.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: gains Attack per Rest beside it.
card_short.u10: End of Turn: permanently buffs every unit with Rest.
card_short.u11: Moved units still build Rest; last moved gains extra.
card_short.u13: Selling a unit pays gold for its Rest.
card_short.u14: Whenever a unit Wakes, permanently buff its neighbours.
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: lends Rest to enemies, cutting their Attack.
card_short.u16: Can't hold Rest; takes others' Rest to grow permanently.
card_short.u17: Rest is never used up; gains no longer cause Wakes.
card_short.u18: Every 12th Wake: copy your biggest Sleeper to hand.
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: all Rest floods into stats, then Wake.

builds.name: The Long Sleep
builds.line: Nobody moves; the Eldest keeps Rest climbing, the Dragon cashes it.

builds.name: The Wake Chain
builds.line: Keep Rest tiny so every buff Wakes; Kurent, Prior, Ribica spread it.

builds.name: Guest Beds
builds.line: Put Rest on another tribe's carries to double their growth.

liked: A counter that doubles every buff, then fires when it empties, felt fresh.
Standouts: Kurent's domino, Dragon's flood, Robber-Knight's lending, Parkelj's anti-synergy engine.
worries: Mother Ribica (watch): copies may come every turn and feed runaway triples.
The Eldest (watch): doubling with other tribes' share-based growth may compound.
changed: Wake timing written: Rest builds last, Wakes queue, fight Wakes are fight-only.
Pool Olmling also Wakes when you play a unit beside it.
Echo Nave Choir doubles only Wake texts, counted as one Wake.
verdict: It suits players who track cross-tribe combos: leave your Sleepers alone and every buff lands twice.
